name: authichain-registry
description: Direct read-only access to the AuthiChain QRON registry over a Postgres connection. Operator tool.
long_description:
This bundle runs the stdio MCP server in `mcp/` against the AuthiChain Postgres registry and exposes two read-only tools: verify_product (look a QRON id up) and list_qrons (the 50 most recent registrations).

It needs a Supabase/Postgres connection string with read access to the registry, so it is for operators who already hold those credentials — not a general-purpose install.

**If you just want to verify records, do not use this bundle.** Add the free hosted server instead: https://authichain.com/mcp — no key, no database, no account. Install instructions at https://authichain.com/mcp/install.

tools.name: verify_product
tools.description: Look a QRON id up in the registry. A row proves the id was registered; it does not inspect a physical product.

database_url.title: Registry connection string
database_url.description: Postgres/Supabase URL with read access to the AuthiChain registry. Use the session pooler on port 6543. Stored by Claude Desktop in the OS keychain, never in this bundle.
